title: Chapter 2: The Long Root
_comment: Chapter 2 remodel (2026-09-10, v2): map tripled in each dimension (was 56x30). Structurally different from Chapter 1 on purpose (heterogeneous levels, not one template reused): instead of sequential maze segments, the Root Tangle FORKS into two independent, vertically-stacked maze paths (Path A rows 1-44, Path B rows 45-88, same columns) that a player chooses between and which reconverge at one shared chamber - then a final single 'Root Gate' maze before the wood. Layout: arrival clearing (cols 2-30), the forked Root Tangle (cols 32-90), the reconverge chamber (92-101), the Root Gate (103-130), the wood beyond (132-165).
